The '''Sorella system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Freeworlds Territory]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was situated on the [[Three Ellas Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].
